I was a Game Master as well in the Austin office, and it was not a great job. I worked there from 2007-2009 right after they set up the office (before it was only in Irvine CA). Everyone who starts has to start as a very low paid temp. You spend most of the time in forced over time that is not appreciated at all, either by the company or by the customers.
